description:
Record money received against threads, one file per thread.

Subcommands:
  log THREAD AMOUNT [-c CURRENCY] [-d YYYY-MM-DD] [-t HH:MM] [-a ACCOUNT] [-n NOTE] [--all] — record a receipt (INTERACTIVE if THREAD is omitted)
  list [THREAD] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD] [--json] — list payments
  statement [--thread T] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD] [--as-of YYYY-MM-DD] [--pdf PATH] [--json] — billed vs received, by thread and currency
  show ID [--json] — show one payment
  edit ID [--amount AMOUNT] [-c CURRENCY] [-d DATE] [-t TIME] [-a ACCOUNT] [-n NOTE] — change fields of a payment
  rm ID [-y] — delete a payment (DESTRUCTIVE)

Flags:
  log: -c 3-letter ISO currency, defaults to the thread's; -d date received, default today; -t time HH:MM, default now; -a account the money landed in; -n free-text note; --all applies to interactive mode only.
  statement: --thread limit to one thread; --since; --until; --as-of statement date driving aging, default today; --pdf render a PDF to this path, requires --thread; --json.
  edit: --amount new amount; -c, -d, -t, -a, -n as for log.
  rm: -y skip confirmation.

Examples:
  ["log", "Projects/SGB", "12500", "-a", "Business current", "-n", "Invoice 004"]
  ["list", "Projects/SGB", "--json"]
  ["statement", "--thread", "Projects/SGB", "--as-of", "2026-09-30", "--json"]
  ["rm", "a1b2c3d4", "-y"]

Notes:
  Never call `log` without THREAD and AMOUNT — it drops into interactive capture and reads stdin.
  Amounts must be positive; there are no negative payments.
  Every payment must have a currency, from -c or the thread's default; unlike hours there is no unbilled case.
  --pdf requires --thread and renders a statement of account using the thread's client_* fields.
  ID is the 8-hex payment id, shared as one namespace with hours entry ids.
